content.text:
**Finding (repaired): Compliant** — no redline proposed.

What changed: the quote now captures the operative language of § 12.3 rather than only the closing acknowledgement. The first sentence — "Nothing restricts Customer from ... hiring any person who responds to general recruitment" — is what functions as the general-solicitation carve-out, and the second sentence confirms we have made no no-hire commitment.

Substance is unchanged: no non-solicit, no-hire, or inducement restriction binds us anywhere in the agreement (the other "personnel" references in §§ 3.1, 14.2 and 30.1 only allocate Vendor's responsibility for its own staff). Because there is no covenant on us, the fallback parameters on duration and scope do not apply, and the deterministic duration/carve-out checks are not meaningful here.
